title: 7 DEFEATS IN A ROW, 0 POINTS, AND NEDVĚD STILL SAYS 'FULL CONFIDENCE'
description:
Czechia: three goals scored, fourteen conceded, and a coach change is 'not up for discussion'.

Pavel Nedvěd is the general manager, so every defeat lands on his desk, and it's a busy desk. Zero points in six games. Three red cards in six games. Then a seventh straight defeat, the longest losing run in Czech national team history. Technically, a record.

Nedvěd says full confidence in Santi Denia. The FIFA ranking has a different view: fifty-third, the lowest since 2017, and now behind Peru. Peru.

Back Denia or pull the plug? Your vote, in the comments.
